items.text: David Montgomery (groin) off injury report after full practices, expected to play TNF vs Colts. Woody Marks (concussion) OUT.
items.why: Full practices all week, no designation; Marks ruled out concussion short week.
items.implication: Montgomery reclaims lead/3-down role TNF; strong RB2/flex vs weak Colts.
items.opportunity: Majority carries/snaps/goal-line with Marks out; reverse prior beneficiary volume.

items.text: Agree with Andy Reid that playing Kenneth Walker (groin) at anything less than 100% would be stupid; Chiefs 15.5-pt home favorites vs Cardinals, huge game at BUF Week 12. Signs point to another Emmett Johnson start.
items.why: Reid: sore groin getting better but don't do something stupid; feeling better but day-to-day. No rush with Johnson's 171 yds/2 TDs prior week.
items.implication: Walker sit again Week 11; monitor practice Thurs/Fri. Handcuff/backup elevates heavily.
items.opportunity: Full lead back volume for fill-in RB vs weak ARI run D; Walker rest for playoff stretch.

items.text: With Chiefs playing next week on Thanksgiving, signs this week point to another week of Emmett Johnson for Kenneth Walker (groin).
items.why: Reid comments + schedule (soft ARI then tough stretch); Johnson monster game prior.
items.implication: Walker managers pivot; Johnson smash start if available.

items.text: I am CLOSING IT OUT on Jaylen Waddle. The target share is nice. The production is not.
items.why: Targets present but fantasy production lacking post-concussion/bye.
items.implication: Sell or sit; fade in lineups despite full practice return.
items.conflict: Full participant Wed practice after concussion protocol, yet production hate.

items.text: Texans: Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) OUT for TNF vs Colts along with other key pieces.
items.why: DNP, ruled out hamstring short week.
items.implication: HOU WR targets redistribute (Nico Collins primary); stream alternatives.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining HOU pass-catchers.

items.text: FULL CHUB(A) FOR MR. HUBBARD! Chuba Hubbard is my RB6 in rest-of-season rankings.
items.why: Strong production and role stability for Carolina.
items.implication: Hold/start confidently ROS; trade-up target if undervalued.
items.opportunity: Lead back volume and goal-line work in CAR offense.

items.text: In first game with Kirk Cousins, Vikings set a season-high in Pass Rate Over Expectation. Clear Kevin O'Connell wants to throw a lot. Confirms prior note on positive PROE potential with Cousins for Jefferson routes.
items.why: Season-high PROE debut Cousins; O'Connell pass-first intent despite prior QB issues.
items.implication: Jefferson volume spike ROS; Vikings pass-catchers elevated, especially playoff DvP favorable (DET/WAS/NYJ).
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Jefferson in high-PROE offense.

items.text: Brock Bowers left early ankle (high-ankle sprain likely low-grade), day-to-day Week 11. Monitor for 0-4 weeks miss potential.
items.why: Left Week 10 early ankle; mechanism suggests manageable but multi-week risk.
items.implication: Game-time or sit risk; Mayer handcuff elevates if out.
items.opportunity: TE backup (Mayer) routes/targets if Bowers sits.

items.text: NE loses Drake Maye, potentially for the season. Everything you need to know before Week 11 team-by-team notes.
items.why: Ankle injury (possible fracture) sidelines potentially season-long; NE on bye Week 11.
items.implication: Drop or IR Maye; stream QBs/waivers for NE replacements; hard for NE positives.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and pass-catcher role shifts if any, but offense struggles noted.

items.text: Omarion Hampton finally got lead-back volume: 22 carries, 105 yards, a touchdown, and 63% of the snaps. With six teams on bye, he’s a start against the Jets.
items.why: Breakthrough lead role snaps/carries/TD vs prior committee.
items.implication: Must-start Week 11 vs NYJ amid byes; elevated ROS outlook.
items.opportunity: Expanded snap share, carries, red-zone as clear lead back.

items.text: Coke heads, I’m sorry. I am CLOSING IT OUT on Jalen Coker. The talent is there. The fantasy production has not been.
items.why: Talent acknowledged but consistent fantasy underproduction.
items.implication: Close out/drop; free roster spot for better waivers.

items.text: No IR for Jordan Addison, per coach Kevin O’Connell.
items.implication: Addison remains rosterable/short-term return candidate; no long IR stint.
items.opportunity: Potential return window keeps him relevant vs stash alternatives.

items.text: We have JT ahead of Chase Brown in the ROS150 half-PPR. In full-PPR, Brown would be further ahead. Updated ROS Top-150 live.
items.why: Half-PPR scoring favors JT volume/role; full-PPR boosts Brown receiving.
items.implication: Trade calculator/ROS valuations adjust; format-specific starts.

items.text: Kaelon Black available 61% Yahoo; 60+ scrimmage yds three straight, scored twice past three; viable flex even with CMC healthy. Top RB waiver target.
items.why: Consistent touches/yards/TDs as SF change-of-pace/handcuff with standalone value.
items.implication: Priority add for flex/bye fill; elite handcuff upside.
items.opportunity: Snaps/carries/receiving even with CMC; expands if injury.
